# pagetoken

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/xpki/v2/internal/pagetoken"
```

Package pagetoken encodes the position of a paged listing as an opaque string and binds it to the request it was issued for.

A token is the base64url encoding of a JSON envelope: a version, a binding and the payload. The binding is a short hash of whatever the caller says the token belongs to \(cryptoprov uses the filter and the field mask of a ListKeysRequest\), so a token presented with another request is rejected instead of resuming a different listing. Tokens are neither secret nor authenticated: whoever holds one can read and forge it, which only moves that caller's own cursor.

```
token, err := pagetoken.Encode(binding, cursor{Marker: "m", Offset: 20})
...
var c cursor
err = pagetoken.Decode(binding, token, &c) // errors.Is(err, pagetoken.ErrInvalid)
```

## Constants

<a name="MaxTokenSize"></a>

```go
const (

    // MaxTokenSize is the longest token Decode accepts, so a caller-supplied
    // string cannot make it decode an arbitrarily large document.
    MaxTokenSize = 8 << 10
)
```

## Variables

<a name="ErrInvalid"></a>ErrInvalid is the cause of every Decode failure: a token that is not one, has another version or was issued for another binding.

```go
var ErrInvalid = errors.New("invalid page token")
```

<a name="Binding"></a>
## func [Binding](<https://github.com/effective-security/xpki/blob/main/internal/pagetoken/pagetoken.go#L39>)

```go
func Binding(v any) ([]byte, error)
```

Binding returns the binding of v: a hash of its JSON encoding. v must marshal deterministically, which structs, sorted slices and maps \(whose keys encoding/json sorts\) do.

<a name="Decode"></a>
## func [Decode](<https://github.com/effective-security/xpki/blob/main/internal/pagetoken/pagetoken.go#L68>)

```go
func Decode(binding []byte, token string, payload any) error
```

Decode reads the payload of token into payload, which must be a pointer. It fails with a wrapped ErrInvalid when token is malformed, too long, of another version or was issued for another binding.
